name: Operation Report - Resolved but not Closed
query:
SELECT
  name AS Ticket_ID,
    ticket_type AS Ticket_Type,

  call_log_date AS Ticket_Raised_Date,
  employee_id AS Emp_ID,

  employee_name AS Emp_Name,

  branch_name AS Branch

FROM
  `tabSahayog Ticket`
WHERE
  dept_name = 'Operations' 
  AND status = 'Resolved';
report_name: Operation Report - Resolved but not Closed
